## Overview

DeepWorks is a modular Python package designed to help developers improve productivity through task prioritization, Pomodoro-style focus planning, break suggestions, and personalized affirmations.

---

## The Problem

Developers often juggle competing tasks, lose focus during long work sessions, and need better guidance for pacing their workday. DeepWorks addresses this by bringing productivity planning and wellness support into a single package.

---

## What I Built

- Contributed to a modular Python package for developer productivity
- Helped implement task ranking and scheduling logic
- Supported features for focus session planning and break recommendations
- Contributed to developer-facing functionality that combines productivity with motivation
